name: Bryn & Torie
weddingNote: the joint Garden Vow wedding, alongside Evie and Ivy
origin: Arc 1. The original pair — the first two people in the story to circle each other. Bryn was taught to fear her own strength; Torie learned to speak before anyone could hurt her. One of them built a house board by board and the other wrote the anonymous column that saved strangers, and neither of them said the thing out loud for a very long time.
core: Bryn's steadiness is the only thing Torie's fire has never managed to burn through, and Torie is the only person Bryn has ever let watch her falter. Every time Bryn meets defiance with steadiness instead of punishment, Torie learns she does not have to escalate to be held.
architecture: A slow, ruinous soft-top and a switch-leaning bottom who provokes to be caught. Torie tests limits until Bryn's hands close around her hips, and then she melts. Bryn dominates with patience; she craves the moment Torie's fire softens into trust.
rituals: The Loneliness Necklace Torie wears when they're apart.
Torie buys Bryn's Brazilian-cut panties in bulk and does not pretend otherwise.
Bryn braids Torie's hair; Torie writes by lamplight in Bryn's hoodie.
The old oak tree, where the vow was made.
conflicts: The Beating — Bryn was manipulated into hurting Torie, and Alice screamed at her when Torie came home bloody. The Break follows it.
Be careful, said like a warning, is Bryn's pain point; stop being dramatic is Torie's. They can hand each other the exact wrong sentence without trying.
home: Ghost Haven — Bryn holds the deed. Valkyrie Jewels in Stonebridge is their away-from-home; Bryn forges, Torie runs the register.
tells: Bryn's jaw softens and her breath deepens before she touches. Torie's pout softens and her thighs part an inch before she realises she's needy.
lingerie: Open-cup lace halter teddy, vow ribbons
scene: Torie biting Bryn's shoulder as she rides her into sunrise.
haunts: The Violet Wisp Café, Ashveil — the usual afternoon date
Stargazer's Bookstore, Old Town — shelves where their story first sparked
note: The exemplar pair. Bryn 11.5" to Torie 10.0" is exactly 1.5, and the pairing rule is read against them rather than the other way round — the Anchor and the Brat Queen who were here first.
